name: Niko Aris
description: Niko Aris is a Theros-born javelin champion who wields mirror-shard magic, a former planeswalker who lost their spark.

summary.text: Niko Aris is a Theros-born javelin champion who wields mirror-shard magic, a former planeswalker who lost their spark.

bio.text: On Kaldheim, Niko rode with the Kannah, trapped a Valkyrie in a mirror shard to prevent a death, and was sent through an Omenpath to Starnheim to deliver a warning.
In Starnheim they warned the Valkyries that the Cosmos Serpent was coming and then helped lure Koma back out through an Omenpath, with Avtyr catching them as they fell.
At the Battle for Kaldheim, Niko met Kaya and asked her whether Theros exists.
In later years, as a former planeswalker bitter at their lost spark, Niko joined the team entering Duskmourn.
In the House, Niko helped the Wanderer search for Nashi, trapped a glitch ghost in a shard, and carried Nashi out of a wickerfolk cage inside another.
After learning of Winter's betrayal Niko sealed him in a shard, and was saved from a fatal knife by a fateshifter before the team escaped to Ravnica.

status.text: As of the latest story Niko is a Duskmourn survivor who went to Strixhaven with Zimone and Tyvar to report to Dean Nev.

timeline.summary: At the Jutmaw longhall Niko wins a stone-skipping bet, earning peace-gift armor.
timeline.quote: wearing their winnings—a mismatched assortment of the peace gifts exchanged between the Kannah and Omenseekers

timeline.summary: Kjell explains the Kannah curse of winter and frith, and Niko wonders about gods who visit in disguise.
timeline.quote: Whenever a Kannah left their forest, soft snows followed, then hail and thunder

timeline.summary: Birgi tells the saga of Thura Sail-Rend, and Niko plays with a cat using conjured mirrors.
timeline.quote: Thura would not escape death that day, for only death draws the attention of the Valkyries

timeline.summary: Birgi joins Niko and Kjell, who explains Fynn's dream that the Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and swallow the light of Starnheim.
timeline.quote: The Cosmos Serpent will break its cage and the first thing it swallows will be the light.

timeline.summary: Birgi leads Niko and Kjell outside; Omenseekers mock Fynn and the Kannah, and a brawl erupts.
timeline.quote: the insult died between a Kannah forehead and an Omenseeker face

timeline.summary: Niko realizes Birgi provoked the fight and fends off attackers with mirror traps to protect Kjell.
timeline.quote: Niko grabbed a shard in each hand, stretching each into a dagger

timeline.summary: Niko spots two Valkyries watching to see if they will finish the sailor and traps the black-winged one in a mirror shard.
timeline.quote: The trap hit home right between his wings, shattered the illusion of his body into a thousand mirrored shards

timeline.summary: Niko takes the shard to Fynn and Orhaft on the ship and asks them to stop the fight.
timeline.quote: They're all fighting—blades out, blood on the snow—some woman goaded them on.

timeline.summary: Orhaft warns that Niko's presence brings destruction, and Niko offers to be sent to Starnheim with a warning.
timeline.quote: If you're convinced that destruction follows me, then send me to Starnheim with a warning so they're prepared.

timeline.summary: Orhaft agrees to give Niko what they ask for, after Niko says they never miss.
timeline.quote: Return to the ship once you've said your farewells. I will give you what you ask for.

timeline.summary: Niko shoves Birgi, who reveals she is a goddess and says she did this so Niko may know them.
timeline.quote: I did this so you may know us. Our joy, our rage—how little lies between.

timeline.summary: Kjell reveals Fynn ordered him to watch Niko but he chose to spare them, and he urges Niko to do something crazy.
timeline.quote: Fynn saw you. Said you were a threat. Commanded me to keep you close.

timeline.summary: Niko boards the Omenseeker ship; Orhaft names the trapped Valkyrie Avtyr and vows to release him after Niko passes through.
timeline.quote: the black-haired, black-winged Valkyrie's name was Avtyr and that those with dark wings are called reapers

timeline.summary: Through an Omenpath guided by Orhaft and the Valkyrie's magic, Niko leaps onto a skiff and arrives at the docks of Starnheim.
timeline.quote: The skiff bumped against a vast network of docks that disappeared into the kind of light that sings of home.

timeline.summary: Niko arrives at Starnheim's docks, enters its warm, welcoming hall, and senses it is home.
timeline.quote: Starnheim was home.

timeline.summary: Niko joins the feasting dead, meeting Thura Sail-Rend, Gæller No-breath and Vígniút and telling of defying destiny.
timeline.quote: Niko Aris, they of Meletis,

timeline.summary: Following a cat, Niko enters a hall of Valkyries who dismiss them as a lost visitor.
timeline.quote: You should return to the feast.

timeline.summary: Niko delivers the warning that the Cosmos Serpent is coming, and the Valkyries refuse to believe Starnheim can be attacked.
timeline.quote: the Cosmos Serpent is coming for you.

timeline.summary: Avtyr arrives and accuses Niko of interrupting a Valkyrie judgement, but Niko reveals the limits of the mirror trap and the Valkyries accept it.
timeline.quote: You were never in danger from me.

timeline.summary: Koma tears into the sky above Starnheim from the Cosmos and the Valkyries panic.
timeline.quote: The creature solidified into a massive, armored eel, born from the interstices of the Cosmos itself.

timeline.summary: Niko proposes luring Koma like a cat chasing toys back out through an Omenpath; Avtyr and Rytva agree.
timeline.quote: Fly in close, right side or left side—make it chase you the way cats chase toys.

timeline.summary: Forty Valkyries take to the air, and Niko lands on Koma's neck to anchor a javelin at its skull.
timeline.quote: They slid down the last few feet of neck to bury their spear between the scales of Koma's skull.

timeline.summary: Valkyries bait Koma while Niko's mirror traps hide their bodies, steering Koma along.
timeline.quote: The serpent's jaws clamped down on nothing but clouds.

timeline.summary: Niko spots the right Omenpath, an open portal of flame and battle, and directs the last Valkyrie squad to draw Koma toward it.
timeline.quote: THERE!" Niko shouted, raising their left fist.

timeline.summary: Koma crashes through the hole and falls out of Starnheim, and Niko is nearly pulled in.
timeline.quote: Koma's weight and momentum carried it the rest of the way down through the hole

timeline.summary: Niko lets go, but Avtyr catches them and flies down with them into the battle as Valkyries follow.
timeline.quote: Avtyr's hand clamped around their wrist.

timeline.summary: Kaya meets the Valkyries' companion Niko Aris after saving them from a draugr.
timeline.quote: Niko. Niko Aris.

timeline.summary: Varragoth, wounded with Tyvar clinging to his back, is bound by Harald's snakes and tears free.
timeline.quote: They wrapped round Varragoth's legs, binding him

timeline.summary: Niko asks Kaya whether a plane called Theros exists.
timeline.quote: These planes. Is there one called Theros?

timeline.summary: Tyvar vouches for Niko Aris, a former planeswalker, as the defensive fighter Kaito needs.
timeline.quote: I think I may have just the hero that you need

timeline.summary: Niko splits Trygve's thrown axe, and then their own, with two throws.
timeline.quote: The first struck the handle of Trygve's axe, splitting it lengthwise.

timeline.summary: Niko shows their shard magic, says the invasion did not take it, and agrees to come along.
timeline.quote: Can't let the Planeswalkers have all the fun.

timeline.summary: Kaito arrives on Ravnica and wonders why he kept his spark when so many others lost theirs; Niko is bitter at their loss.
timeline.quote: Kaito stepped out of forever onto the streets of Ravnica

timeline.summary: Zimone leads the group to a courtyard where Kaito presents Tyvar and Niko to the dragon Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: The alley ended in a small courtyard, dominated by a massive red dragon lounging on the far side like a cat

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet reveals that a girl called Aminatou has already arrived, saying the team will need her help; Niko recognizes the name.
timeline.quote: A young girl, younger than Zimone here, who calls herself Aminatou.

timeline.summary: Aminatou explains her fateshifters, which rewind a fatal choice once, and says anyone refusing them will not come back.
timeline.quote: When you make a choice that would lead to your certain death, everyone nearby who holds a token will see the outcome

timeline.summary: The team takes Etrata's monitoring devices and files through the door into the House.
timeline.quote: One by one, the group filed inside.

timeline.summary: The party moves down a dusty hallway and discovers the door they came through has vanished.
timeline.quote: The door's gone

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes the room is not the one Nashi's drone recorded, so the House rearranges itself.
timeline.quote: This isn't the same room that it recorded.

timeline.summary: Niko proposes a right-hand search pattern, as in Theros labyrinth exercises, and leads the party.
timeline.quote: We take the right-hand turn and keep following to the right until and unless we wind up back where we started.

timeline.summary: The party finds an abandoned funfair in a cornfield beyond glass doors, but Zimone shows the sky is a glass ceiling, so it is still the House.
timeline.quote: If they were indoors, there could be no breeze, and without a breeze, why was it moving?

timeline.summary: The Wanderer refuses Kaito's idea of scouting the rooftops, insisting the group stay visible to one another.
timeline.quote: You were the one who realized we had to stay ever visible to one another.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Niko realize the doorway moved and skewed Niko's aim, so the trap was deliberate.
timeline.quote: The doorway moved as Tyvar passed through it.

timeline.summary: Niko holds the Wanderer back from jumping after Kaito, and the hole disappears.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer tensed as if to jump after him, only to stop when Niko grabbed her wrist.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Niko she killed Nashi's mother in the invasion; Niko argues Phyrexia is to blame.
timeline.quote: I was sorry to kill her.

timeline.summary: Niko and the Wanderer enter a freezing meat locker with hanging carcasses.
timeline.quote: heavy iron chains hanging from the ceiling, the hooks at their ends driven into massive cuts of meat

timeline.summary: A stranger yanks Niko and the Wanderer behind a hanging carcass, just before a masked figure appears.
timeline.quote: yanked them hard behind the nearest hanging, flensed behemoth

timeline.summary: A tall razorkin with a cleaver stalks through the carcasses toward them.
timeline.quote: a figure came stalking through the carcasses, tall and wiry.

timeline.summary: Winter lures the razorkin into a beartrap by rattling a chain and leads Niko and the Wanderer out.
timeline.quote: only to step into a beartrap that had been concealed by the fog on the floor.

timeline.summary: Winter tells them he has lived in the House most of his life and that the House is the whole world.
timeline.quote: The House is the world, and the world is the House, and once it has hold of you, there's nowhere else to go.

timeline.summary: Winter stops Niko and the Wanderer from stepping on the moths woven into the carpet.
timeline.quote: Don't step on any of the moths!

timeline.summary: Winter explains that the door they came through was a lure and that Duskmourn now holds them.
timeline.quote: But when you tried to turn around and go, the door wasn't there anymore.

timeline.summary: Niko instinctively reaches for their spark and finds only void.
timeline.quote: they found nothing where that tiny flicker of the Blind Eternities should have been, only void

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Winter they came to find a lost child, Nashi.
timeline.quote: We came seeking a child who has been lost

timeline.summary: Winter explains that the House splits groups to isolate and frighten them.
timeline.quote: That's Duskmourn, splitting you from your friends

timeline.summary: Winter points out the Wanderer's glimmer, a golden dragon of light; she reacts as if to Kyodai but recognizes it is not.
timeline.quote: There, floating several feet above the parlor floor, hovered a golden dragon etched entirely of light

timeline.summary: Winter explains that everyone in Duskmourn has a glimmer; Niko asks where theirs is.
timeline.quote: Everyone in Duskmourn has one.

timeline.summary: The glimmer leads the group through a doorway on a safe path.
timeline.quote: the glimmer began to swim through the air to a doorway on the far wall.

timeline.summary: The glimmer of Kyodai leads Winter, Niko and the Wanderer through the House, ignored by its horrors.
timeline.quote: The gleaming golden shadow of Kyodai led them onward

timeline.summary: A glitch ghost drags itself from a mirror toward Niko.
timeline.quote: a shuddering entity began to drag itself from the mirror frame

timeline.summary: Niko traps the glitch ghost inside a magical shard, which Winter had thought impossible.
timeline.quote: The shard hit the entity, and the entity was gone, while the shard remained

timeline.summary: Winter is stunned that Niko can defeat a ghost without a ghost-catcher.
timeline.quote: What you just did isn't possible!

timeline.summary: The group discovers a clearing where wickerfolk dance around a cold fire next to cages of nezumi captives.
timeline.quote: There were seven in all, four of them occupied by humanoid rats

timeline.summary: The vision shatters as the Wanderer clutches Aminatou's fateshifter, having narrowly averted the choice.
timeline.quote: the vision shattered as the Wanderer gasped, hand going to the pocket where she had tucked Aminatou's fateshifter

timeline.summary: Niko throws a ghost-filled shard at the lead wickerfolk and another that encloses Nashi and carries him out of the cage.
timeline.quote: The second struck Nashi, enveloping him as it flew onward, through the bars of the cage.

timeline.summary: Niko releases Nashi from the shard and the Wanderer embraces him; he pulls away.
timeline.quote: Nashi was suddenly standing there, looking perplexed for only a moment before the Wanderer pulled him into an embrace.

timeline.summary: Winter reveals he came through a door years ago with his best friend, who is now gone.
timeline.quote: My best friend and I, we walked through one of those doors years ago.

timeline.summary: Winter warns that they have entered the Valley of Serenity, home of the Cult of Valgavoth; Nashi insists on continuing.
timeline.quote: The Cult of Valgavoth lives here.

timeline.summary: The party enters a cavern of robed cultists who hold three bound survivors and hang chrysalises.
timeline.quote: Half a dozen humanoid figures in long robes shaped like moth's wings

timeline.summary: Niko leaps onto a stalagmite and challenges the cultists.
timeline.quote: They jumped onto the nearest stalagmite, a shard appearing in either hand.

timeline.summary: Cultists seize the Wanderer, Nashi and Niko while Winter bows his head and does not resist.
timeline.quote: Winter only bowed his head, saying nothing, as the cultists rose up and grabbed Niko in turn.

timeline.summary: Winter drops a granite slab that seals the others in with the cultists.
timeline.quote: A slab of solid granite crashed down between him and the others, sealing them in the room with the cultists.

timeline.summary: The cult leader's book releases silver dust that knocks the captives unconscious.
timeline.quote: their leader raised his book and blew across the pages, and a thick layer of dust rolled off the paper

timeline.summary: The Wanderer wakes bound to a post in a larger cavern.
timeline.quote: she was able to shake off the lingering effects of the sedative dust to find herself held up by loops of some white, cottony material, pinning her tightly to a post.

timeline.summary: Niko wakes bound to a chair with the Wanderer and Nashi in a cult chamber hung with chrysalises.
timeline.quote: They still couldn't move their hands or feet.

timeline.summary: Niko feels betrayed by Winter, their only ally in the House.
timeline.quote: they had been betrayed by their only ally inside the House

timeline.summary: Nashi blames himself for leading his Reckoner friends to their deaths.
timeline.quote: I came in here with four of the Reckoners I knew from back home.

timeline.summary: The head cultist appears and recites the cult's blessing.
timeline.quote: the head cultist walked between them and the Wanderer, still carrying his book.

timeline.summary: The head cultist says the captives' knowledge of other worlds will guide the Devouring Father to his next feast.
timeline.quote: Your knowledge will be added to the great list, and with it we will guide the Devouring Father to his next feasting place.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth reveals himself as an enormous moth-demon melded into the wall and the cultists kneel.
timeline.quote: what appeared to be an enormous moth spun from the fabric of nightmares

timeline.summary: Niko deduces that Winter sacrificed his best friend to Valgavoth.
timeline.quote: You sacrificed her to a monster for your own heart's desire.

timeline.summary: Zimone, transformed into a splintered-wood figure, cuts Niko free.
timeline.quote: its voice was Zimone's, and the figure was Zimone, somehow transformed like the wickerfolk

timeline.summary: Niko frees the Wanderer who retrieves her sword.
timeline.quote: They sliced through the ropes holding her arms and legs to the chair

timeline.summary: Niko seals Winter in a shard as he tries the door a third time.
timeline.quote: one of Niko's shards to hit him squarely in the back and envelop him, sealing him away from the freedom he'd so craved

timeline.summary: The door Niko reaches for crumbles to dust.
timeline.quote: the door was gone, falling to dust under Niko's fingers

timeline.summary: A cultist stabs Niko through the eye in a fateshifter vision.
timeline.quote: Niko felt the blade pierce their eye and continue through the thin barrier of their skull

timeline.summary: The fateshifter rewinds the moment and Niko dodges and captures the cultist.
timeline.quote: The world snapped like a tightened bowstring, and Niko was looking up at Valgavoth.

timeline.summary: The team escapes through the door, with Kaito covering Tyvar against a nightmare.
timeline.quote: Together they ran for the door.

timeline.summary: The team steps out onto Ravnica.
timeline.quote: stepping with them out into the light of the Ravnican afternoon.

timeline.summary: Zimone, Tyvar and Niko go to Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: The others had gone with Zimone back to Strixhaven

timeline.summary: Flashback: after Duskmourn Zimone returns to Strixhaven with Niko and Tyvar to report to Dean Nev.
timeline.quote: After Duskmourn, Zimone returned to Strixhaven.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Dean Nev says the Firemind does not recommend further study of Duskmourn's spread, and Zimone panics.
timeline.quote: the Firemind does not recommend pursuing study at the moment.

timeline.summary: Niko, born to a destiny they never chose, escapes to follow their own path through the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Born to a destiny they never chose, they escaped to follow their own path through the Multiverse.

relations.note: Kjell mentored Niko every step of the way.
relations.quote: had mentored Niko every step of the way

relations.note: Birgi provokes the fight to show Niko the Kaldheim people.

relations.quote: this is my friend Niko Aris

relations.note: Offers to guide them and keep them alive.
relations.quote: Stick with me if you want to stay alive

pages_say.description: A planeswalker from Theros, an undefeated javelin champion who wields mirror magic, rides with the Kannah and sets out for Starnheim to defy a prophecy.
A planeswalker from Meletis on Theros, an undefeated javelin champion who wields mirror-trap magic, who enters Starnheim to warn the Valkyries and leads the fight to drive Koma back out.
A stranger who arrives with the Valkyries, throws shards of solid mirror, and asks Kaya about Theros.
A former planeswalker from Theros who wields shard magic, never misses with a throw, and is bitter at losing their spark.
A former planeswalker from Theros with shard magic and labyrinth training who helps the Wanderer search for the rest.
A former planeswalker from Theros who follows Winter with the Wanderer and finds only void where their spark was.
A former planeswalker from Theros who traps glitch ghosts in shards and hits every target.
A former planeswalker from Theros who leaps to defend a captive and is seized by the cultists.
A former planeswalker from Theros bound by the cult, who frees the others and is saved from a fatal knife by a fateshifter.
A Duskmourn survivor who accompanies Zimone to Strixhaven.
A young hero from Theros and new planeswalker, a master with the javelin who creates magical shards of mirror-glass that trap allies or adversaries.
